title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Greetings. I’m doing a story on J.D.’s trade v██ue for Sunday’s paper. E-mailed H██ey but she’s off. My question -- not for quotes or attribution, just so I’m not completely wrong -- if J.D. is traded by the bobblehead giveaway on July 28, would you guys still give them away?

“But the conundrum the Tigers could be in with Martinez goes far beyond the possibility of thousands of fans receiving his Game of Thrones-themed bobblehead at a time in which he could be playing for another team.”
It's a speci██ ticket package that you purchase in advance. It's not a mass giveaway. Let me find out how we are offering. And confirm that you would still receive.
It's a very limited number, "not thousands" but we don't want that number out there.
I’m just using the bobblehead scenario to like, illustrate how the Martinez situation is complicated. It’s a baseb██l story
It's around 1,400. I would recommend to our marketing group that we still give them to the fans that night regardless because they bought the speci██ ticket that includes the ██ item.
